name: Have I Been Pwned
steps_summary: Enter your email on the opt-out page and confirm via the emailed link to be excluded from public search.
notes: SEED ENTRY: confirm. ADD YOUR OWN lookup_service entries here (the email-OSINT-style sites you researched) with source_url and last_verified.

name: EmailOSINT
steps_summary: Open the removal page, enter your email, solve the hCaptcha, click 'Send confirmation link', then click 'Confirm removal' in the email you receive. Per the site's confirmation email, this deletes stored search history for the address and blocks future lookups on their platform.
notes: Completed and tested by the project author: a later lookup of the address was blocked. Request email dated 12 Sept 2026. Re-check occasionally.

name: Fingerprint.to
steps_summary: Enter your email, click Email me a code, pass the bot check, then type the 6-digit code from your email. Blocks that exact email from search. Names and usernames need the contact page.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself. Cloudflare Turnstile shown in a real browser; a person must tick it.

name: OSINTSearch
steps_summary: Choose suppress my email, send the verification link, click the link in your email. Removes the email from their site only.
notes: Researched 2026-10-22 from the source page. NOT tested: confirm the steps on the site yourself. Turnstile markers found on the page.

name: OSINTLeak
